description: A supplied actual raw classical arithmetic certificate of \(A\), supported in the original HA axioms and a finite additional context \(\Gamma\) over \(X\), transforms into an actual raw intuitionistic HA certificate of \(A^{\mathsf N}\), over the identical \(X\) with additional context exactly \(\Gamma^{\mathsf N}\). Its finite arithmetic support lies in the original HA axiom set.
